mechanism: Verapamil inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, increasing fluphenazine plasma concentrations and risk of antipsychotic toxicity; both drugs have negative inotropic and QT-prolonging effects.
action: Monitor for increased extrapyramidal symptoms, QT prolongation, and cardiac arrhythmias; consider alternative antipsychotic or calcium channel blocker; obtain baseline and periodic ECGs.
